# meok-eu-platform-worker-mcp

> EU Platform Workers Directive (2024/2831) compliance — employment-status presumption, algorithmic-management disclosure, human oversight of significant decisions, worker data protection, member-state transposition tracking, misclassification-risk forecast. Targets EU gig-economy platforms (€20bn market). Transposition deadline 2 Dec 2026. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_employment_status_presumption
- check_algorithmic_management_disclosure
- check_human_oversight_decisions
- check_worker_personal_data_protection
- check_algorithmic_transparency_consultation
- check_member_state_transposition
- forecast_misclassification_risk
- prepare_eu_platform_audit_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-eu-platform-worker-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-eu-platform-worker-mcp/
